context:
Goal: every guard rule is tied to its test, so a cull or audit can find it.
Problem (rule): lint/rule_mechanisms.json keys its rows on CLAUDE.md rule anchors. 72 guard rule ids have no row, and no anchor fits them.
Based on (read): decision cull-rules says prose leaves only with proof, and the rule-map row names a test.
Based on (read): lint/rule_mechanisms.json rows are keyed by CLAUDE.md anchors only (lane read, 14:38 CST).
Departs from: main, where 72 guard rule ids have no row — option a adds a guards section keyed by guard rule id.

options.gain: Each guard rule is findable and pinned to its test, and a new guard rule with no row turns the audit red.
options.label: A guards section keyed by guard rule id, each row naming its test; lint/test_rule_audit.py requires a row for each id the guard emits (recommended)
options.lose: One lane of work, and 72 rows to fill.

options.label: One row per CLAUDE.md anchor that lists its guard ids
options.lose: Many guard ids fit no anchor, so they stay untied.

options.label: An exempt list, with a reason per id
options.lose: Guards stay untied, and the list goes stale.

short: Guard rules in the rule map: own section, anchor rows, or exempt list
title: Where should the rule map tie each guard rule to its test?
why: Lane notes-fix-merge-ci (session_013NEJL17gMWcgUJ44gi3ZRs) found 72 guard rule ids with no row in the rule map (the note said 3). The map's shape needs your pick.
